rationale: Superseding TASK-112 implementation build maps only passing executable evidence to task criteria. Source content remains committed at 4aad04d; unrelated package-smoke fixture drift is recorded as issue note, not TASK-112 test evidence.

context_boundary.reason: Gateway pass can hand the next loop a bounded source-backed packet instead of builder chat memory.

trailers: CodeWiki-Checks: npm run typecheck; node --experimental-strip-types tests/tasks/TASK-112/roadmap-task-reuse-boundary.test.mjs; node --experimental-strip-types tests/smoke/roadmap-task-boundary.test.mjs; wiki_audit profiles=task,changed,source-contract,alignment task_id=TASK-112: warning only
checkpoint_commit.note: After implementation validation passes, a local checkpoint commit may capture validated content for inspection. Task-close, sprint-close, and ship-ready metadata belong in later gate-specific commits.

reload_guidance.message: Pi extension, skill, runtime, or API files changed. Run `/reload` in Pi before relying on live extension behavior; CodeWiki compaction does not reload extension code and never restarts Pi automatically.

isolation_requirement.reason: Implementation validation requires independent validator context and checked content evidence.

audit_requirement.reason: Gateway profiles require deterministic audit evidence for their build or boundary context.

checks: accepted upstream builds with gateway pass

risk.reason: Semantic product/system/task change must trace to accepted user semantics before lower-layer promotion.

fresh_context.reason: Implementation validation requires independent validator context and checked content evidence.

fast_path.reason: High-risk work must cite approval evidence before lower-layer promotion.
